print('CAMERA', o['intrinsic'], o['camera_to_world'])

steps.text: The scene shows the hammer and nail close together beside the wooden block, while the hand is at the edge of its reachable workspace. I’m checking another calibrated view to estimate their world positions before moving in.

import limited_client as robot,numpy as np
o=robot.observe('topview'); d=o['depth_m']; K=o['intrinsic']; T=o['camera_to_world']
for v in (250,260,270):
 for u in (180,200,220,240,260):
  z=float(np.median(d[v-1:v+2,u-1:u+2])); p=np.array([(u-240)*z/K[0,0],(v-240)*z/K[1,1],z,1]); w=T@p
  print((u,v),round(z,3),np.round(w[:3],3))
PY
